p: instruct him: Is this the way for a man that will learn, to strive with God? which he reproves in Job.
vile: By which he shows that he repented and desired pardon for his faults.
my judgment: Signifying that they who justify themselves condemn God as unjust.
majesty and excellency: Meaning, that these were proper to God, and belonged to no man.
their faces in secret: Cause them to die if you can.
save thee: Proving by this that whoever attributes to himself power and ability to save himself, makes himself God.
behemoth: This beast is thought to be the elephant, or some other, which is unknown.
with thee: Whom I made as well as you.
grass as an ox: This commends the providence of God toward man: for if he were given to devour as a lion, nothing would be able to resist him, or content him.
He is the chief of the: He is one of the chief works of God among the beasts.
he that made him can make: Though man dare not come near him, yet God can kill him.
and hasteth not: He drinks at leisure, and fears nobody.
